title: "iLand - previous releases"

This page contains older official releases of the iLand software and example packages. Find the latest release on the main [download](../download.qmd) page.

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="iLand version 2.1 (2025-07-23)"}

Release 2.1 focused on three key areas: a powerful new forest management library (*abe-lib*), enhanced deadwood dynamics, and various cross-platform build improvements.

* **Release Notes**: [iLand 2.1 Release Notes](../blog/blogpost61-release-iland-21.qmd)
* **Downloads**:
  * <a href="/get_iland/iland_download.php?file=iLandPackage2.1-win.zip" class="btn btn-outline-primary btn-sm">Download Windows Package (ZIP)</a>
  * <a href="/get_iland/iland_download.php?file=iLandPackage2.1-mac.dmg" class="btn btn-outline-primary btn-sm">Download macOS Package (DMG)</a>
  * [View Source Code on GitHub](https://github.com/edfm-tum/iland-model/releases/tag/v2.1)

:::

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="iLand version 2.0 (2024-07-17)"}

Release 2.0 included a major rewrite of core simulation interfaces, improved performance, and upgraded cross-platform builds.

* **Release Notes**: [iLand 2.0 Release Notes](../blog/blogpost60-release-of-iland-20.qmd)
* **Downloads**:
  * <a href="/get_iland/iland_download.php?file=iLandPackage2.0.zip" class="btn btn-outline-primary btn-sm">Download Windows Package (ZIP)</a>
  * [View Source Code on GitHub](https://github.com/edfm-tum/iland-model/releases/tag/v2.0)

:::

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="iLand version 1.0 (2016-11-16)"}

Version 1.0 represented the "feature complete" milestone of the original model specification, introducing the agent-based forest management engine (ABE) and the bark beetle disturbance module.

* **Release Notes**: [iLand 1.0 Released](../blog/blogpost58-iland-10-released.qmd) and [Release in Numbers](../blog/blogpost57-iland-10-release-in-numbers.qmd)
* **Downloads**:
  * <a href="/get_iland/iland_download.php?file=iLandPackage1.0.zip" class="btn btn-outline-primary btn-sm">Download Windows Package (ZIP)</a>
  * [View Source Code on GitHub](https://github.com/edfm-tum/iland-model)

:::

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="iLand version 0.8 (2014-08-01)"}

Version 0.8 included the fire disturbance module and legacy dynamics used in Seidl et al. (2014, *Ecol. Appl.*).

* **Release Notes**: [iLand 0.8 Release Notes](../blog/blogpost52-new-iland-release-08.qmd) | [Publication](http://dx.doi.org/10.1890/14-0255.1)

:::

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="iLand version 0.7 (2013-10-14)"}

Version 0.7 introduced the first disturbance module (wind disturbance mechanics), applied in Seidl et al. (2013, *Environ. Model. Software*).

* **Release Notes**: [iLand 0.7 Release Notes](../blog/blogpost47-iland-v07-release-notes.qmd) | [Publication](http://dx.doi.org/10.1890/14-0255.1)
* **Downloads**:

:::
